card.name: Dose words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word dose or dosage right after a drug name, in sentences about adjusting or reducing the dose. Also digits and spaces inside dose tables and numeric dose figures.

modes.label: Dose after drug name
modes.description: The word dose or dosage follows a drug name in an instruction to adjust it.
modes.example: The riociguat<< dose>> may need to be reduced.

modes.label: Digits in dose figures
modes.description: Numbers, decimal points or spaces within dose amounts and table layouts.
modes.example: 11 to 17 years <<3>>0 mg 18 years and older

card.writes: It pushes toward words about settings and arrangements, which fits adjusting a configured amount.
card.plain: It fires on the word dose, or on the numbers in a dose table, where the label tells how to set or adjust the amount.
